PDYN.physical_anchor: None nameable — Palladyne AI licenses a perception/motion-planning software platform (Sensei) to third-party robot and drone integrators; it builds no physical hardware itself since divesting the Guardian XO exoskeleton line to Sarcos Defense in 2024.
PDYN.value_chain_position: AI software layer licensed into third-party robotic/autonomous systems; owns no hardware, so it fails the physical-anchor test despite the robotics-adjacent keyword hints.

PENG.physical_anchor: Manufactures physical data-center hardware — specialty DRAM/memory modules and Penguin Computing-branded HPC/AI servers, including liquid-cooled racks — boxes it actually builds and ships.
PENG.value_chain_position: OEM manufacturer of memory modules and HPC/AI server systems for hyperscale and enterprise data centers; a real physical-hardware maker, but its AI-compute-hardware chain has no member id in this book (not grid equipment, not nuclear, not a robotics- or quantum-specific toll-taker).

PERF.physical_anchor: None — AR/AI virtual try-on and skin-diagnostic software (YouCam apps) licensed to beauty brands and retailers; no physical product.
PERF.value_chain_position: SaaS/AR software vendor for beauty e-commerce; no chain participation.

PGY.physical_anchor: None — an AI credit-underwriting network that prices and funds consumer loans for bank/fintech lending partners; a financial network, the textbook anti-Visa case, not a physical product.
PGY.value_chain_position: AI credit-decisioning marketplace connecting lenders to institutional capital; no physical or chain tie.

PI.physical_anchor: Designs and sells RAIN RFID chips, readers and antennas — physical silicon and radio hardware embedded in tags for item-level asset tracking.
PI.value_chain_position: Sensing/identification layer feeding warehouse and supply-chain automation — RFID ICs and readers give automated logistics systems real-time inventory visibility.

PICS.physical_anchor: Unverifiable — company identity and product cannot be confirmed from available data; its financials are internally inconsistent with a $1.7B-mcap software microcap ($10.4B TTM revenue, $8.9B cash, $915M EBITDA), which reads as a data-quality artifact rather than a real operating profile.
PICS.value_chain_position: Unknown — flag for data-quality review, not a genuine chain member.

PL.physical_anchor: Owns and operates a fleet of 200+ Earth-imaging satellites (Dove/SuperDove/Pelican) that physically capture and downlink daily imagery.
PL.value_chain_position: Satellite Earth-observation operator selling imagery/analytics subscriptions; the Aerospace & Defense industry tag pulled it into the nuclear_smr screen (reactor components & naval/defense nuclear layer), but Planet Labs has no nuclear, grid, robotics-automation, or quantum tie.

PLSE.physical_anchor: Manufactures the CellFX nanosecond pulsed-field ablation console and handpieces — physical energy-delivery medical devices.
PLSE.value_chain_position: Capital-equipment medical device maker (dermatology/cardiac ablation); no robotic arm or manipulator, so it misses the robotics_automation chain's surgical-robotics layer despite the Medical Instruments industry tag.

PLUG.physical_anchor: Manufactures hydrogen fuel cells, electrolyzers and hydrogen fueling/production equipment — physical hardware it builds and installs.
PLUG.value_chain_position: Hydrogen fuel-cell and electrolyzer maker serving material-handling and industrial hydrogen markets; a distinct hydrogen-economy value chain not represented by any of this book's five chains (not grid-transformer equipment, not nuclear, not a robotics or quantum toll-taker).

POET.physical_anchor: Designs and fabricates photonic integrated circuits and optical-engine chips — physical semiconductor components for high-speed data-center/AI-cluster optical interconnects.
POET.value_chain_position: Photonics & lasers component layer (the same layer anchored by COHR in this chain) — supplies optical-engine chips whose core market is AI-datacenter interconnect but which can also serve quantum-networking/photonic-qubit hardware.

PONY.physical_anchor: Designs, builds and operates a fleet of physical autonomous vehicles (robotaxis and robotrucks) fitted with lidar, radar and camera sensor stacks.
PONY.value_chain_position: Humanoid/autonomous-vehicle developer layer — operates the physical AV fleet and full-stack autonomy software, monetizing on dated robotaxi-permit and fleet-scale milestones ahead of profitability.

PRCT.physical_anchor: Manufactures the AquaBeam Robotic System — a physical robotic console and handpiece for image-guided urologic (BPH) surgery.
PRCT.value_chain_position: Surgical-robotics capital-equipment maker selling console placements plus per-procedure disposable handpieces — a razor/razorblade toll-taker on urology surgical volume.

PRGS.physical_anchor: None — enterprise application-infrastructure and data-connectivity software (OpenEdge, MOVEit, Chef); no physical product.
PRGS.value_chain_position: Horizontal enterprise software vendor; no chain tie in this book.

PUBM.physical_anchor: None — programmatic digital-advertising exchange (sell-side platform) software; no physical product.

QBTS.physical_anchor: Designs, builds and operates physical quantum-annealing processors (the Advantage system) with dilution-refrigerator cryogenics.
QBTS.value_chain_position: Qubit hardware platform layer — annealing-based quantum computer manufacturer selling cloud access (Leap) and hardware to government/enterprise customers ahead of a dated error-correction/commercial-advantage track.

QDEL.physical_anchor: Manufactures clinical diagnostic instruments and rapid-test hardware (immunoassay/clinical-chemistry analyzers) — real physical instruments, but for clinical diagnostics, not factory/warehouse/surgical robotics or humanoid automation.
QDEL.value_chain_position: IVD instrument and reagent maker; caught by the Healthcare/Medical-Instruments industry filter but outside this chain's automation thesis.

QNT.physical_anchor: Builds and operates trapped-ion quantum computers (the H-Series systems) — physical qubit hardware plus control-laser/optics stacks.
QNT.value_chain_position: Qubit hardware platform layer — trapped-ion quantum computing developer (Honeywell/Cambridge Quantum lineage) monetizing on dated government contracts and error-correction/logical-qubit milestones ahead of commercial-scale revenue.

QUBT.physical_anchor: Manufactures photonic quantum-computing systems (the Dirac series) built on its own thin-film lithium-niobate (TFLN) photonic-chip foundry — physical hardware.
QUBT.value_chain_position: Qubit hardware platform layer (photonic) plus an in-house TFLN photonic-chip foundry — a vertically-integrated small-cap spanning the photonics and qubit-hardware layers, pre-commercial revenue funded by dated program/pilot contracts.

QUIK.physical_anchor: Designs and sells low-power eFPGA IP and embedded FPGA/AI-accelerator semiconductor chips (EOS S3, ArcticPro) — real physical silicon, but generic edge-sensor/IoT processing, not tied to grid, nuclear, robotics-specific, or quantum-hardware chains.
QUIK.value_chain_position: Fabless semiconductor IP/chip vendor for always-on sensor-fusion and edge-AI applications across consumer/industrial IoT; caught by the broad Semiconductors industry filter, not a genuine chain rider.

RAL.physical_anchor: Manufactures precision test-and-measurement and sensing instruments (Tektronix oscilloscopes, Keithley source-meters, industrial sensors) — physical bench and embedded instrumentation.
RAL.value_chain_position: Instrumentation toll-taker layer selling measurement, control-electronics and sensing gear used both on automation/robotics test benches (machine-vision & motion-control validation) and in quantum-lab cryogenics & control-electronics setups (source-meters, oscilloscopes) — broad diversified exposure rather than a pure-play.
